user.title: Set up Open Connex HA
user.description: Enter the controller address, such as {example_address}, and an API token generated in the controller's Settings → Security. Use the API token, not your web password. Setup only reads saved settings. A trusted PEM CA certificate is optional for HTTPS connections.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Connex credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Generate or copy an API token in the controller's Settings → Security and enter it for the same controller. A web password cannot be used here. Previous commands will not be repeated.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Open Connex HA
reconfigure.description: Update the connection to the same controller. Re-enter its API token from Settings → Security; it is required and is never prefilled. Add a separate integration for a replacement controller.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller. Check its address, availability, and HTTPS certificate.
error.invalid_auth: A valid API token is required. Generate or copy one in the controller's Settings → Security; do not use the web password.
error.incompatible: The controller returned an unsupported API response.
error.invalid_origin: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address without an API path, query, or embedded credentials.
error.invalid_certificate: Enter a valid PEM CA certificate or leave the field blank.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different controller.

invalid_value.message: Use a temperature within the zone's displayed limits in 0.5° steps in its native unit. In Eco mode, the displayed temperature minus the Eco offset must be 10–30 °C or 50–86 °F. Eco offsets are −9 to +9 in whole native degrees.

unsupported_mode.message: Connex supports heating with Normal or Eco presets. Off, on, and toggle commands are unavailable.

unit_changed.message: The zone's unit changed. Review the refreshed values before issuing a new command.

closing.message: The integration is unloading. No new command was sent.

invalid_auth.message: Update the controller's API token in the integration settings. This command will not be repeated.

not_found.message: This zone is no longer available on the controller.

conflict.message: The controller has conflicting work for this zone, such as active pairing. Wait until it finishes before issuing another command.

rate_limited.message: The controller is at request capacity. This command will not be repeated automatically.

unavailable.message: The controller is not ready to accept commands. Check whether it is in standby or has a local fault.

cannot_connect.message: Could not read the controller. No control request was sent.

incompatible.message: The controller returned an unsupported API response.

server_error.message: The controller reported an error. This command will not be repeated automatically.

identity_mismatch.message: The configured address belongs to another controller. Reconfigure the connection before sending commands.

unknown_outcome.message: The command's acceptance is unknown. Saved settings will be refreshed, but the command will not be repeated. Check before issuing another command.

identity_mismatch.title: Connex controller identity changed
identity_mismatch.description: The configured address now returns a different controller ID. Commands are disabled. Reconfigure this integration with the original controller's address, or add the replacement as a separate integration.
